name: research-router
description: A context-aware research agent: one research tool that picks the right SerpApi engines, runs them in parallel, and returns compact, cited, token-budgeted context.
long_description: ResearchRouter provides one intelligent research tool. It detects intent (web, news, academic papers, code, jobs, shopping, places), splits multi-part requests into parallel searches, resolves follow-ups such as 'compare them' or 'the second paper' from earlier results, and deduplicates, ranks and compresses results to a configurable token budget while keeping every source's title, URL and date. Optionally, it saves findings to an Obsidian vault and recalls them later, clearly labelled as older information.

serpapi_api_key.title: SerpApi API Key
serpapi_api_key.description: API key used for SerpApi searches.

google_api_key.title: Google Gemini API Key
google_api_key.description: Optional. Used by Gemini to classify ambiguous queries; without it, built-in rules are used.

obsidian_vault_path.title: Obsidian Vault (optional)
obsidian_vault_path.description: Optional. Vault folder for persistent research memory (notes go in Research/).
